definitions.explanation: Making something better, often through continuous small changes.

examples.japanese: {生活|せいかつ}を{改善|かいぜん}したい。
examples.english: I want to improve my lifestyle.

examples.japanese: {品質|ひんしつ}の{改善|かいぜん}に{取|と}り{組|く}む。
{状況|じょうきょう}は{改善|かいぜん}している。

notes:
{改善|かいぜん} is famous worldwide as a Japanese business philosophy of continuous improvement.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜を{改善|かいぜん}する (to improve ~)
- {改善|かいぜん}の{余地|よち} (room for improvement)
- {改善|かいぜん}{点|てん} (points to improve)

Related: {改良|かいりょう} (improvement of products/systems)
